description: Consumo de energía en minería is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Minería. Reportes estadísticos del consumo de energía en la minería chilena. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Minería. Its tags are Estadísticas, consumo, minería. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-05-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Attribution License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
